```{r}
library(tidyverse)

ghg <- read_csv(
  "https://bcdanl.github.io/data/GHG_emissions_by.csv"
)

positive_weak <- read_csv(
    "https://bcdanl.github.io/data/UStweets_positive_weak_2017.csv"
  )

tweets <- bind_rows(
  positive_weak = read_csv(
    "https://bcdanl.github.io/data/UStweets_positive_weak_2017.csv"
  ),
  positive_strong = read_csv(
    "https://bcdanl.github.io/data/UStweets_positive_strong_2017.csv"
  ),
  negative_weak = read_csv(
    "https://bcdanl.github.io/data/UStweets_negative_weak_2017.csv"
  ),
  negative_strong = read_csv(
    "https://bcdanl.github.io/data/UStweets_negative_strong_2017.csv"
  ),
  .id = "sample"
)
```

```{r}
ghg |>
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    parties = n_distinct(Party),
    first_year = min(Year),
    last_year = max(Year),
    sectors = n_distinct(Sector),
    missing_values =
      sum(is.na(GHG_emissions))
  )
```

```{r}
ghg |> 
  skimr::skim()
```


```{r}
us_focus <- ghg |>
  filter(
    Party ==
      "United States of America",
    Sector %in%
      c("Energy", "Waste"),
    Year >= 2005,
    !is.na(GHG_emissions)
  )


is_GHG_NA <- ghg |>
  filter(
    is.na(GHG_emissions)
  ) |> 
  count(Sector)

is_GHG_NA_agri <- ghg |>
  filter(
    is.na(GHG_emissions),
    Sector == "Agriculture"
  ) 
```


```{r}
ghg_working <- ghg |>
  select(Party, Year, Sector, GHG_emissions) |>
  rename(
    party = Party,
    year = Year,
    sector = Sector,
    emissions = GHG_emissions
  ) |>
  relocate(year, party, sector)
```



```{r}
ghg |>
  filter(GHG_emissions == NA)
```

```{r}
ghg |>
  filter(!is.na(GHG_emissions)) |>
  select(
    Party, Year, Sector, GHG_emissions
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(GHG_emissions)) |>
  slice_head(n = 3)
```


```{r}
ghg_change <- ghg |>
  group_by(Party, Sector) |>
  arrange(Year, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    annual_change = GHG_emissions - lag(GHG_emissions),
    decreased = annual_change < 0
  ) |>
  ungroup()
```


```{r}
df <- data.frame(x = 1:10,
                 y = c(2,4,6,8,10,
                       1,3,5,7,9))
df <- df |> 
  mutate(
    x_lag = lag(x),  # previous value
    x_lead = lead(x),  # next value
    y_cumsum = cumsum(y),    # running sum
    y_cummean = cummean(y),   # running average
    y_cummin = cummin(y),    # running minimum
    y_cummax = cummax(y)    # running maximum
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    x_chg = x - lag(x)
  )
```

```{r}
    y_cummin = cummin(y),    # running minimum
    y_cummax = cummax(y)    # running maximum
  ) |>

  )
```

```{r}

ghg_eg <- data.frame(country = c("A", "A", "A", "B", "B", "B"),
                 year = c(2023, 2024, 2025, 2023, 2024, 2025),
                 GHG = c(100, 110, 105, 200, 180, 165))

ghg_eg <- ghg_eg |> 
  mutate(GHG_prev_year = lag(GHG)) |> 
  mutate(annual_change = GHG - lag(GHG)) |> 
  relocate(annual_change, .after = GHG_prev_year)
```



```{r}

ghg_eg <- data.frame(country = c("A", "A", "A", "B", "B", "B"),
                 year = c(2023, 2024, 2025, 2023, 2024, 2025),
                 GHG = c(100, 110, 105, 200, 180, 165))

ghg_eg <- ghg_eg |> 
  group_by(country) |> 
  mutate(GHG_prev_year = lag(GHG)) |> 
  mutate(annual_change = GHG - lag(GHG)) |> 
  relocate(annual_change, .after = GHG_prev_year)
```

```{r}
ghg |>
  filter(Year == 2017) |>
  group_by(Sector) |>
  summarise(
    reporting_parties = sum(!is.na(GHG_emissions)),
    total_reported = sum(GHG_emissions, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(total_reported))
```


```{r}
us_change <- ghg |>
  filter(Party == "United States of America",
         Year %in% c(1990, 2017)) |>
  arrange(Sector, Year) |>
  group_by(Sector) |>
  summarise(start = first(GHG_emissions),
            end = last(GHG_emissions),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(change = end - start,
         pct_change = change / start) |>
  arrange(pct_change) |> 
  relocate(pct_change, .before = change)

us_change
```


```{r}
us_change |>
  mutate(
    is_increased = if_else(
      change > 0,
      T,
      F
    )
  )
```

```{r}
us_change |>
  mutate(
    pct_change2 = if_else(
      start > 0,
      100 * change / start,
      NA_real_
    )
  )
```



```{r}
tweets <- bind_rows(
  positive_weak = read_csv(
    "https://bcdanl.github.io/data/UStweets_positive_weak_2017.csv"
  ),
  positive_strong = read_csv(
    "https://bcdanl.github.io/data/UStweets_positive_strong_2017.csv"
  ),
  negative_weak = read_csv(
    "https://bcdanl.github.io/data/UStweets_negative_weak_2017.csv"
  ),
  negative_strong = read_csv(
    "https://bcdanl.github.io/data/UStweets_negative_strong_2017.csv"
  ),
  .id = "sample"
) |>
  mutate(
    sentiment = if_else(
      str_starts(sample, "positive"), "positive", "negative"
    ),
    strength = if_else(
      str_ends(sample, "strong"), "strong", "weak"
    )
  )
```


```{r}
counts <- tweets |>
  count(
    sentiment, strength,
    name = "tweets"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    share = tweets / sum(tweets)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(tweets))

counts
```


```{r}
tweets |>
  mutate(suspicious_encoding = str_detect(content, "[âÂ]")) |>
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    flagged = sum(suspicious_encoding),
    flagged_share = mean(suspicious_encoding)
  )
```


```{r}
hurricane_pattern <- regex(
  "\\bhurricanes?\\b",
  ignore_case = TRUE
)

tweets |>
  filter(str_detect(content, hurricane_pattern)) |>
  count(sentiment, strength,
        name = "tweets") |>
  mutate(share = tweets / sum(tweets)) |>
  arrange(desc(tweets))
```

```{r}
tweets |>
  mutate(
    hurricane = str_detect(content,
      regex("\\bhurricanes?\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    wildfire = str_detect(content,
      regex("\\bwildfires?\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    flood = str_detect(content,
      regex("\\bflood(s|ed|ing)?\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    drought = str_detect(content,
      regex("\\bdroughts?\\b", ignore_case = TRUE))
  ) |>
  summarise(
    across(hurricane:drought, \(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
```


```{r}
tweets |>
  mutate(
    hurricane = str_detect(content,
      regex("\\bhurricanes?\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    wildfire = str_detect(content,
      regex("\\bwildfires?\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    flood = str_detect(content,
      regex("\\bflood(s|ed|ing)?\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    drought = str_detect(content,
      regex("\\bdroughts?\\b", ignore_case = TRUE))
  ) |>
  summarise(
    hurricane = sum(hurricane, na.rm = TRUE),
    wildfire = sum(wildfire, na.rm = TRUE),
    flood = sum(flood, na.rm = TRUE),
    drought = sum(drought, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
tweets |>
  group_by(sentiment, strength) |>
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    unique_text = n_distinct(content),
    duplicate_rows = rows - unique_text,
    duplicate_share = duplicate_rows / rows,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(duplicate_share))
```

```{r}
tweets |> 
  distinct()
```


```{r}
ghg |> 
  group_by(Sector) |> 
  summarise(ghg_median = median(GHG_emissions, na.rm = T)) |> 
  arrange(-ghg_median)
```


```{r}
ghg |> 
  arrange(Sector, -GHG_emissions) |> 
  group_by(Sector) |> 
  mutate(ranking = dense_rank(-GHG_emissions),
         ranking_min = min_rank(-GHG_emissions),
         ) |> 
  filter(ranking <= 3)
```

```{r}
ghg |> 
  group_by(Sector) |> 
  slice_max(GHG_emissions, n = 3,
            with_ties = F)
```



```{r}
ghg |> 
  group_by(Sector) |> 
  slice_max(GHG_emissions, prop = 0.01)
```



```{r}
# Count unique tweet texts by sentiment and strength.
tweets |> 
  count(sentiment, strength)

tweets |> 
  mutate(
    hurricane = str_detect(content,
      regex("\\bhurricanes?\\b", ignore_case = TRUE))
  ) |> 
  group_by(sentiment, strength) |> 
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_unique = n_distinct(content),
    n_hurricane = sum(hurricane),
    pct_hurricane = 100 * n_hurricane / n
  )
```
